title_en: In Dry Lake, Super Apartment 2+1+2 With Porch for Sale!!!
description_en: In Dry Lake, Super Apartment 2+1+2 With Porch for Sale!!! The apartment is located on the sixth and last floor of a new building equipped with an elevator, currently under construction. The apartment has a total area of ​​123.3 m2, of which 13.9 m2 is the veranda area. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a super veranda with a fantastic view. The orientation of the apartment from east and west, as well as the free view, allow sun and natural lighting throughout the day. The area in which it is located is one of the most sought after for a comfortable lifestyle as well as for investment due to the high demand for rent.
